description:
Queremos convertir la tecnología y el conocimiento en herramientas que ayuden a los agricultores a tomar mejores decisiones, aprovechar sus recursos y enfrentar los desafíos del clima.

¿Por qué unirte? Porque no necesitas saberlo todo, solo tener iniciativa, creatividad y ganas de aportar. Aquí tus ideas pueden convertirse en soluciones reales para el campo.

NEXPAN: Todos conectados, un mismo propósito.
summary:
The project consists of the design and implementation of a 100-square-meter pressurized lunar dome that functions as a closed-loop Bioregenerative Life Support System (BLSS/ECLSS) to ensure human self-sufficiency on the lunar surface.
To achieve this, the architecture unifies Kilopower nuclear energy, a multi-layer regolith shield against radiation, and an electromagnetic damping system (Maglev) that neutralizes the impact of moonquakes and reduced-gravity sloshing. Inside, a circular trophic network operates, including Spirulina microalgae, rice and sweet potato crops, and an aquaculture polyculture of tilapia and carp, supported by bacterial biofiltration and water condensers (CHX).
Finally, the project integrates an Android mobile application under the Human-in-the-Loop approach, adapting NASA Earth observation models to monitor telemetry and issue early warnings, providing a dual solution for space colonization and sustainable agriculture on Earth.
details: The project centers on designing and implementing a 100-square-meter pressurized lunar dome that functions as a closed-loop Bioregenerative Life Support System (BLSS/ECLSS) to ensure autonomous human survival on the lunar surface. Functioning as an advanced habitat, it operates through a deeply interconnected circular architecture that unifies a 40 kW Kilopower nuclear fission reactor for stable energy, a multi-layer regolith radiation shield, and a Maglev electromagnetic levitation and damping system designed to neutralize tectonic moonquakes and reduced-gravity sloshing. Inside this controlled environment, a biological trophic network thrives, integrating Spirulina microalgae photobioreactors, hydroponic rice and sweet potato crop modules, and a closed aquaculture polyculture of tilapia and carp supported by bacterial biofiltration and condensed heat exchangers (CHX) that recycle 80% of water for fertigation while purifying 20% into potable water. The primary benefits of this infrastructure include absolute resource circularity, high structural resilience against extreme lunar environments like the -130°C night or solar particle events, and complete dietary and respiratory self-sufficiency for a dedicated crew. The anticipated impact spans both space exploration and terrestrial sustainability, validating NASA Earth-observation telemetry models such as MODIS, ECOSTRESS, and SMAP, while offering dual-use applications for closed-loop agriculture in harsh, arid, or climate-degraded regions on Earth. From a technical standpoint, the development stack uses Android Studio, Java, differential equation solvers for thermodynamic and biochemical mass-balance modeling, and an interactive HTML5/JavaScript Canvas engine running real-time 60 FPS simulations with automated failure-cascade mechanics and forensic post-mortem analyzers. The project demonstrates profound transdisciplinary creativity by transforming an Earth-based agricultural challenge into an electromechanically stabilized lunar ecosystem managed through an intuitive Human-in-the-Loop mobile interface. Finally, the multidisciplinary team meticulously accounted for stringent homeostatic physical boundaries such as maintaining water temperatures between 24.0°C and 26.0°C, a strict pH envelope of 6.20 to 6.50 to prevent iron and phosphate precipitation, and dissolved oxygen thresholds above 5.50 mg/L to compensate for the complete absence of natural buoyant convection under 1/6 g gravity conditions.
dataRefs: SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive): Used as a reference model for monitoring and controlling substrate moisture.
ECOSTRESS Mission (NASA): Adapted to measure thermal stress and crop canopy surface temperature.
GPM Mission (NASA): Employed as a key reference for water balance and condensation algorithms.
LRO Mission (NASA): Integrated for collecting data on cosmic radiation and lunar regolith characteristics.
FSP Technical Documentation / Kilopower (2022): NASA technical documentation on surface fission power systems (40 kW Deployable FSP Paper).
NETS FSP Presentation (2023): NASA technical presentation on fission reactors (NETS 2023 FSP Presentation FINAL).
Lunar Climate and Meteorology (NASA): Documentation from the Science Mission Directorate on weather and climate on the Moon.
BIG IDEA Challenge (NASA / NIA): Reference documentation regarding space agriculture (People and Places for Space Agriculture).
projectRefs: ESA MELISSA Project: European Space Agency initiative simulating a closed aquatic ecosystem based on bacteria, algae, and higher plants for waste recycling.
Android Studio & Kotlin SDK: Official integrated development environment and programming language used for building the object-oriented mobile application and user interface engine.
HTML5 / JavaScript Canvas Engine: Open web technologies utilized to prototype interactive real-time telemetry simulations and graphical rendering at 60 FPS.
ResearchGate Agricultural Studies: Open-access academic literature regarding crop-microalgae co-culture and nutrient utilization dynamics.
ResearchGate Thermal Control Systems Documentation: Reference literature concerning thermal control architectures for long-duration lunar habitats.
Antigravity (2026): Design and diagramming tool used for creating the lunar dome architecture flowchart.

Gemini (AI Collaborator): Advanced artificial intelligence model used as an assistant for engineering, software development, thermodynamic modeling, and technical documentation writing of the project.
